epics.title: Local Docker Compose Environment
epics.jtbd: When a developer or tester runs the project locally, I want to be able to start the full stack via docker-compose and check its health, so that the product can be observed in a real running state.
requirements: R1: A docker-compose.yml file at the repository root must successfully start the full product stack.
R2: The running stack must expose a health-check endpoint to verify it is operational.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml with health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the local environment setup for this epic, I want to configure docker-compose and a health-check, so that the stack starts up and its health is verifiable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh checkout of the repository, When I run docker-compose up, Then all required services start up correctly without errors.
Given the services are running, When I send a request to the health-check endpoint, Then I receive a success status indicating the stack is healthy.
